shot.title: 毕业：被朋友叫到一起
shot.start_end_and_action: Wide smartphone group-photo framing under the large campus tree beside the teaching building, late afternoon. The protagonist and the same ponytailed girl are now eighteen, still in white school shirts and dark bottoms. A small group of classmates arranges itself in two loose rows. The boy and girl begin with a small gap; a friend beside them gestures for them to stand closer. They each take half a step toward the gap and smile awkwardly. Keep ordinary graduation-day clothes, no mortarboards or university gowns. Camera remains at eye level, stable and wide enough to see their feet and the familiar building. End with the group finally ready for the photo.
